_comment: Emulator config for infra/atproto/publish-check.sh only. Never deployed.
It exists because the functions emulator can only fire Firestore triggers
against a Firestore emulator it started itself, so the end-to-end check
cannot reuse the one `yarn dev:up` is already running. Ports are offset
from firebase.json's for exactly that reason: both stacks coexist.
Lives at the repo root because firebase-tools resolves `source` relative
to the directory holding the config.
